property_summary: For any fuzzed bytes4 probe, if the probe is the ERC165 interface id 0x01ffc9a7 then c.supportsInterface(probe) must return true (ERC165 compliance via the super chain); the mutant replaces super.supportsInterface with false, so the ERC165 id returns false.

For any fuzzed interfaceId, c.supportsInterface(interfaceId) must return true exactly when interfaceId is one of the interface ids of IERC1155, IERC1155MetadataURI, or IERC165 (ERC-165 self-description via the super chain); the mutant drops the super.supportsInterface fallback, so the IERC165 id (and any id served only by ERC165) wrongly returns false.

For any query with the IERC165 interface id (type(IERC165).interfaceId), c.supportsInterface must return true via the ERC165 super fallback; the mutant replaces super.supportsInterface(interfaceId) with false, so the ERC165 id is reported unsupported.
